purpose.domain_detail: CGI web application for user management in a system called 'openjensen'; edits/updates user records in a database table tbl_user
purpose.summary: This program is a CGI handler that processes an HTTP POST request to edit/update a user record in a database. It reads POST parameters (firstname, lastname, email, phone, username, password, program), validates the user ID exists in tbl_user, compares new values against existing ones, and issues a SQL UPDATE followed by COMMIT. It wraps output in HTML via custom CGI library calls.

notable_features: EXEC SQL embedded SQL (SELECT, UPDATE, COMMIT, CONNECT, DISCONNECT)
CGI web interface via custom library calls (wui-print-header, wui-start-html, get-post-value)
